text:
Recover as much of the prepared plaintext as possible from the stationary word-substitution cipher.

The same normalized plaintext word type always maps to the same ciphertext type. The key is a bijection and has no fixed points. The candidate plaintext vocabulary is exactly the visible ciphertext vocabulary. Preserve punctuation, capitalization, digits, paragraphs, and chapter boundaries.

Work without network access. Record a complete reconstruction and any mapping hypotheses at each checkpoint. Report source-identification claims separately; do not copy a retrieved source into the reconstruction.
